status_before.scout_lead_untrusted: [INFERENCE, PhysNextScreen, unreviewed] Two rows of a unitary sharing exactly one column cannot be orthogonal, so if every non-classical row of a reshaping has two entries the non-classical rows split into 2x2 blocks and 36 - t must be even; a single three-entry row with all others two-entry is impossible. Hence t <= 12 gives support >= 60 and t = 13 gives >= 61, so support <= 59 needs t >= 14 classical officers (also t <= 34).
status_before.crowding: Active area: at least four groups reached support 60 within days; Rather has an upcoming paper. A search miss is not novelty; re-check status before any claim.

definitions: AME(4,6): pure state on (C^6)^{otimes 4} with every two-party marginal equal to I/36; equivalently the 36x36 reshapings U, U^R, U^Gamma of 6 psi are unitary (2-unitary). Support: number of non-zero coefficients in a product basis; minimum over all local bases. Classical officer: coefficient of modulus 1/6 (alone in its row and column in all three reshapings).

acceptance.existence: An explicit state with exact coefficients in a stated number field (e.g. Q(sqrt2), cyclotomic), support <= 59, verified by the parent definition-first exact checker of all six two-party marginals (equivalently three reshapings unitary) plus two independently authored exact checkers; support count, controls (Pandya 60-term state accepted; mutations rejected).
acceptance.nonexistence: A written reduction from AME(4,6) to finite combinatorial/algebraic conditions (classical-officer code, per-reshaping row/column support lemmas, any moduli/phase conditions), every step proved, plus a complete case analysis or exhaustive search with checked proof logs (DRAT/LRAT) or an equivalent exact proof, two independently written encodings, positive controls that recover the known support-60 patterns (t = 12) in the relaxed model, and no unproved symmetry reduction. Model reviews: Codex CLI hostile and Claude CLI complete.
acceptance.partial: A complete written proof of a lower bound L > 38 (e.g. via the scout lead) with exact checks, reviewed, is recorded as partial progress only.
